units.title: 表格宽度 containment、revision 与回归合同
acceptance_criteria: 启用宽屏时 data-markdown-table 外壳不超过 selected Markdown 当前内容宽度
表格固有宽度超出时只在表格直接子树水平滚动，不让整段正文或页面滚动
普通窄表、正文、composer、right rail 与 Markdown 主题样式不受影响
卸载或关闭宽屏后宿主表格 margin/wide-block 行为完整恢复
PageRuntime implementation revision 11 在 bootstrap、Swift bridge、测试与文档一致
test_points: fixture 验证稳定 data attribute selector、100% containment 与直接表格子树 overflow
负向断言禁止 hashed table class、全 Markdown root overflow 与 table width 强制覆盖
adapter 重复 update 不重复写 style，uninstall 恢复既有 host style
CDP bridge 与 PageRuntime revision 热升级回归
全量 ExtensionCoreTests、Release 安装签名审计及隐私安全 live table geometry gate
contracts: 输入为 wide-layout marker 下 selected Markdown 内稳定 data-markdown-table 与 descendant table
输出仅为 adapter-owned style node 内的 scoped CSS；不改 DOM、配置、正文或表格内容
宿主无稳定表格标记时规则不命中并保持原生
risks: 选择器过宽可能让整段 Markdown 横向滚动
直接覆盖 table width 会破坏列宽与窄表
依赖 CSS module hash 会随 ChatGPT 升级失效
revision 漏同步会让已打开页面继续复用旧实现

reason: main-inline:strict:single-indivisible-runtime-revision-contract; dispatch adds no independent write scope and independent REVIEW remains mandatory

summary: wide-layout revision 11 now constrains stable data-markdown-table shells to the selected Markdown content boundary and delegates intrinsic overflow to the direct native table subtree without hashed selectors or table-width overrides; fixture, bridge and documentation contracts were updated.

verification.command: xcodebuild -project CodexAppExtension.xcodeproj -scheme CodexAppExtension -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath /tmp/codex-app-extension-table-scroll test -only-testing:ExtensionCoreTests/AdapterFixtureTests -only-testing:ExtensionCoreTests/PageRuntimeTests -only-testing:ExtensionCoreTests/CDPPageRuntimeBridgeTests CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO

summary: review fix excludes nested menu/listbox/dialog table shells and table bodies from containment, and adds a real WKWebView geometry regression proving wide-table internal scroll, narrow-table non-scroll, page/Markdown non-overflow, intrinsic table width preservation, transient overlay exclusion, and native layout restoration.
